description: Business-process scope for an SAP conversion, per Business Area: Changed/Unchanged/To-Assess/Out-of-scope, complexity, and (when an Application Map was cross-referenced) supporting applications. Produced by skills/conversion-scoping as a real .xlsx via build_scope_workbook.py -- this schema mirrors that script's actual input JSON shape exactly (see its docstring), not an independently-invented one, so that following either this schema or the script produces the same result.

title.description: e.g. "Client Name — Business Process Scope". Carries client/date context; there is no separate client/generated_at field.

areas.description: Keyed by Business Area name (e.g. "Finance", "Manufacturing") -- one array of process rows per area, not a list of area objects.

stream.description: Optional sub-grouping within the area, e.g. "Accounting and Financial Close".

driving_item.description: e.g. the Simplification Item ID driving this row.

technical_blocker.description: true when driven by a Simplification Item consistency error needing engineering remediation, not a business decision. Read by workshop-scheduling to exclude the row from discussion-time complexity and list it as an FYI item instead.

applications.description: Supporting application(s), only when an Application Map was cross-referenced. A string or a list of strings -- the script accepts either.

notes.description: One entry must state this is a planning-level draft to be re-validated during Fit-to-Standard/Design-phase workshops -- never drop this caveat.
